# Third-Party Skills (Git Submodules)

This directory contains curated research skills from the open-source community, integrated as Git submodules.

## Submodules

### 1. anthropics-skills
**Repository**: [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills)

Official Anthropic skills including doc-coauthoring, canvas-design, and more.

### 2. imbad0202-research
**Repository**: [Imbad0202/academic-research-skills](https://github.com/Imbad0202/academic-research-skills)

Comprehensive academic research pipeline with paper writing, review, and deep research workflows.

### 3. lylll9436-paper-polish
**Repository**: [Lylll9436/Paper-Polish-Workflow-skill](https://github.com/Lylll9436/Paper-Polish-Workflow-skill)

16+ specialized paper polishing skills including de-AI pattern removal, section-specific refinement, and reviewer simulation.

### 4. andrej-karpathy-skills
**Repository**: [multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills](https://github.com/multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills)

Research best practices and guidelines from Andrej Karpathy.

### 5. orchestra-research
**Repository**: [Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs](https://github.com/Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs)

22+ ML research skills covering topics from model architecture to paper writing.

## Usage

### After cloning this repository

Initialize submodules:
```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

### Update to latest versions

```bash
git submodule update --remote --merge
```

### Access skills

Skills are organized within each submodule:
- `anthropics-skills/skills/`
- `imbad0202-research/` (root level)
- `lylll9436-paper-polish/skills/`
- `andrej-karpathy-skills/skills/`
- `orchestra-research/` (root level)

## Total Skills

- **Built-in**: 6 Research Copilot skills
- **Third-party**: 30+ community skills
- **Total**: 36+ skills covering the complete research lifecycle
